exposure: Neonatal early-onset Group B streptococcus (EO-GBS) disease
Positive blood culture prior to NEC diagnosis
Type of feed prior to diagnosis (total parenteral nutrition, mother's or donor expressed breast milk, trophic, full and high calorie feeds)
cohort: The study included 131 newborns (and a larger group of 579 newborns for EO-GBS analysis) admitted to Children's Hospital: New Orleans.
finding: Neonatal EO-GBS disease showed a strong correlation with NEC, with GBS positive newborns having significantly higher odds of NEC (OR = 5.37).
